SELECT id AS batchId, remaining_points, batch_detail, created_time
FROM points_batch
WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND owner_type = #{ownerType} AND first_expire_date < NOW() AND remaining_points > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE(batch_detail, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( expire_date DATE PATH '$.expire_date', remaining INT UNSIGNED PATH '$.remaining' )) AS bd WHERE bd.expire_date < NOW() AND bd.remaining > 0)
ORDER BY first_expire_date FOR UPDATE

SELECT id AS batchId, remaining_points AS remainingPoints, batch_detail AS batchDetail, used_points AS usedPoints, created_time AS createdTime, cumulative_remain
FROM (SELECT id, remaining_points, batch_detail, used_points, created_time, SUM(remaining_points) OVER (ORDER BY created_time) AS cumulative_remain
FROM points_batch
WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND owner_type = #{ownerType} AND first_expire_date > NOW() AND remaining_points > 0) AS t
WHERE t.cumulative_remain < (SELECT MIN(cumulative_remain) FROM (SELECT SUM(remaining_points) OVER (ORDER BY created_time) AS cumulative_remain FROM points_batch WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND owner_type = #{ownerType} AND first_expire_date > NOW() AND remaining_points > 0) AS t2 WHERE t2.cumulative_remain >= #{dedPoints})
ORDER BY created_time FOR UPDATE
